From Rolling Stones · Price: only one mark at a time (two at 13th), and it fades if you mark another.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: mark a creature within 30 ft (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}). It gains weakness to all damage equal to half your level (minimum 2): until the start of your next turn on a success, for 1 minute on a failure; a critical success negates.
  • 5: Surge: the mark lasts 1 minute even on a success.
  • 9: A marked creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to your stand.
  • 13: Two marks.
  • 17: The weakness equals your level.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.YCtIbeCXNkdOetfw]{Effect: Doom Mark}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
